description: This file implements security-related functions for a FastAPI application, including password hashing, JWT token creation, and user retrieval with optional dev bypass.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a user, used for querying user data.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verifies a plain password against a hashed password using pbkdf2_sha256.

methods.name: _token_exp_seconds
methods.description: Retrieves JWT expiration time from environment variable or defaults to 3600 seconds.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with a subject and optional expiration delta.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Retrieves the current user from JWT token, with optional dev bypass for authentication.
